capability: Native active tenant-admin redacted due queue preview, 25 items/page; all dispatch/schedules blocked.
advisor_assessment: All security/performance WARN/ERROR counts unchanged. Unused-index INFO count decreased from 921 to 919 after fixture access. No index removed or new table/index created.
limits: Preview explicitly requires one organization and active mapped native tenant admin. Optional connection filters must belong to that organization.

Delivery rows must join same-org alert/connection, active recipient membership, valid channel/open alert state and bounded recorded attempt/due metadata. Recovery rows must join the failed/partial job on the same connection.
UUID cursor pagination fetches at most 26 rows, returns at most 25 and exposes only IDs/status/attempt/due metadata; it is a live queue view, not a frozen multi-page snapshot.
Recorded due metadata is not sender/recipient identity, provider availability, connector readiness, successful delivery or safe retry execution.

No email, in-app notification, escalation enqueue, queue claim, attempt update, bot creation/login, temporary membership, connector invocation or schedule activation occurred. Real existing queues remain unchanged.
Legacy cron/dispatch-token modes cannot bypass native identity. Default dispatch/manual/scheduled requests return 409 after tenant authorization.

Sending requires verified recipients/sender, idempotent outbox and atomic claim. Recovery requires reviewed least-privilege worker authority, connector idempotency/readiness and completion reconciliation.
No customer-data copy, hosted app cutover, main merge, final source delta or source retirement.
